public_api.plane_input: Required SupportPlane in build; runtime ParcelDetectorConfig(supportPlane=...) on inputConfig.
public_api.camera_calibration: Read each synchronized ImgFrame.getTransformation(); no custom calibration types or build argument.
public_api.value_construction: Ordinary constructors with read-only properties for parcels and cuboids; frozen metadata/result records validate without rewriting fields. No explicit object.__setattr__ calls in new parcel values.

synchronization_revision.implementation: ThreadedHostNode with native host Sync for pointCloud/color/left/right; run gets a synchronized group and drains config with tryGet.
synchronization_revision.complete_groups: One scene call per complete group. DEVICE timestamp span is below 10 ms on a shared device clock. Sequence counters may differ.
synchronization_revision.incomplete_groups: No scene call or result; a later complete frame can recover.
synchronization_revision.configuration: Initial SupportPlane in build. Latest queued full ParcelDetectorConfig applies before a scene. In-flight updates apply to a later scene; batches retain their plane snapshot.
synchronization_revision.queue: Bounded blocking config input, drained in Python. Combined native Sync pipeline with two prequeued custom config messages crashed on DepthAI 3.11 when queueSize=1 and nonblocking; default blocking queue passes. Standalone queue-only probe did not reproduce.
synchronization_revision.removed: Stamped ParcelPlane stream, explicit gravity, manual scene synchronization, private message datatype rechecks, and inconsistent pointCloud/cloud local names.

metadata_revision.distortion: Perspective and Fisheye metadata feed the frozen projector; unsupported models fail.
metadata_revision.camera_pose: Calibrated camera-to-reference pose requested in millimeters and inverted with float64 NumPy.
metadata_revision.cloud_coordinates: DEFAULT native common-reference millimeter XYZ with identity custom transform and calibrated translation. Cloud source pose is not applied twice.
metadata_revision.native_configuration_guard: Reject incompatible initial native PointCloud coordinates, units, custom transforms, or spec translation. Coordinate settings must remain fixed at runtime.
metadata_revision.coverage: 44 native metadata/message/node checks on Python 3.10 and 3.12. Includes actual host Rectification from distorted 64x48 input to 80x36 RAW8 with virtual intrinsics, cleared distortion, and 75mm baseline. Actual generated-cloud and hardware execution remain untested.
metadata_revision.image_relationship: Same scene interval, shared device timestamp clock, and calibrated common reference. Images need not be the original cloud-generator inputs or have matching resolution/aspect ratio. Raw or rectified pixels require their matching delivered-grid calibration.
